nodes.label: False-Positive-First Checks
nodes.rationale: A heuristic that alarms on a valid harness is worse than having no heuristic.

nodes.label: Dynamic Workflow Routing Decision
nodes.rationale: Predefine orchestration only when its shape is itself a repeatable artifact.

nodes.label: Principle-Centered Density
nodes.rationale: Durable reasons and high-signal gotchas should displace generic instructions the model already knows.

nodes.label: Progressive Disclosure as an Optimum
nodes.rationale: Content is split only when load timing differs because over-splitting causes silent routing failure.

nodes.label: Enforcement Layering
nodes.rationale: Advisory behavior belongs in CLAUDE.md or skills, while non-negotiable behavior belongs in hooks and permissions.

nodes.label: Enforcement Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Advisory context belongs in CLAUDE.md and skills; deterministic guardrails belong in hooks and permission rules.

nodes.label: Thin Workflow Orchestration
nodes.rationale: Keep fan-out, collection, and gates in code while leaving judgment in agent prompts.

nodes.label: Workflow Availability Fallback
nodes.rationale: Version, plan, opt-in, and disablement gates require a plain-subagent fallback.

nodes.label: Verification Loop
nodes.rationale: Reliable large-scale orchestration needs an executable check or adversarial verification phase.

nodes.label: Divergent and Convergent Question Style
nodes.rationale: Open conversation fits unbounded discovery, structured choices fit bounded decisions, and repository facts should come from inspection rather than repeated questions.

nodes.label: Harness Spec as Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: harness spec as single source of truth

nodes.label: Spec Approval Gate
nodes.rationale: Generation begins only after persisted intent has been explicitly approved.

nodes.label: Conditional Re-entry Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Each re-entry mode loads only the interview or synchronization guidance it needs.

nodes.label: Evidence-Bounded Discovery Strategy
nodes.rationale: Reduce first-visit uncertainty and measure directionally without promising growth or causal attribution.

nodes.label: Single Maintained Wiki Surface
nodes.rationale: One canonical docs/wiki surface avoids redirects and fragmented navigation.

nodes.label: Directional Measurement
nodes.rationale: Rolling windows, overlapping channels, and confounders support directional learning rather than causal proof.

nodes.label: Persisted Rationale and Evidence
nodes.rationale: Configuration alone does not preserve rejected alternatives, user intent, validation evidence, or lifecycle history, so the harness spec persists them.

nodes.label: Spec and E2E Approval Gates
nodes.rationale: Generation requires explicit approval of the complete proposed spec, and behavioral E2E requires separate consent because it consumes tokens and can execute actions.

nodes.label: Deliberate Declines
nodes.rationale: Recording a considered layer as declined distinguishes deliberate absence from an overlooked requirement.

nodes.label: Sync Mode Drift Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Unexpected files and missing components may reflect intentional teammate changes, so reconciliation preserves current files until the owner chooses a resolution.

nodes.label: Authority Routing
nodes.rationale: Advice belongs in context, reusable procedures in skills, and non-negotiable behavior in justified deterministic controls.

nodes.label: Evidence-Driven Escalation
nodes.rationale: Observed failures justify moving advice to deterministic control, always-loaded procedures to skills, or noisy agents back into the main flow.

nodes.label: Inconclusive E2E Handling
nodes.rationale: Runner uncertainty must remain inconclusive evidence rather than being promoted to a product claim.

nodes.label: Behavioral E2E Validation
nodes.rationale: A real headless session supplies evidence for one approved observable scenario, while isolation is not a security sandbox and grading remains separate.

nodes.label: Cumulative Validation Evidence Levels
nodes.rationale: Structural, hook, and session checks establish different contracts and accumulate without substituting for one another.

nodes.label: Validation and Automation Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Deterministic validation, interactive interviewing, E2E evidence, and drift detection each have explicit limits and do not justify broader claims.

nodes.label: Evidence-Driven Harness Improvement
nodes.rationale: A focused improvement starts from one reproducible failure, routes it to the owning surface, validates with the matching evidence level, and preserves unrelated approved behavior.

nodes.label: Single Active Installation Path
nodes.rationale: Only one of plugin, skills CLI, and development symlink should be active to prevent duplicate skill registration.

nodes.label: Operational Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Cached plugins, executable controls, external distribution surfaces, and generated artifacts require review and deliberate installation choices.

nodes.label: Four Routing Questions
nodes.rationale: Route each need by enforcement, load time, context cost, and who needs and uses it.

nodes.label: Deliberate-Home Completeness Definition
nodes.rationale: Completeness means every identified need has a deliberate home, not that every possible layer exists.

nodes.label: Pull Request Soft Failure
nodes.rationale: External outages stay visible on pull requests without blocking unrelated documentation work.

nodes.label: Apply the keep/cut filter to the why

nodes.label: Empirical Rule Reduction
nodes.rationale: Overlapping constraints may be removed only with evaluation; Anthropic's reported reduction is evidence for an empirical method, not a universal percentage or performance claim.

nodes.label: Harness Mental Model
nodes.rationale: Project outcomes depend on model capability plus repository context, procedures, tools, and controls that are not contained in model weights or one-off prompts.

nodes.label: Harness as a System of Surfaces
nodes.norm_label: harness as a system of surfaces
nodes.rationale: The smallest useful combination of context, rules, skills, controls, agents, workflows, and a spec is preferable to generating every possible surface.

nodes.label: Judgment and Verified Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Case-sensitive decisions should use model judgment, while crisp unacceptable states should be verified or blocked by deterministic controls.

nodes.label: Progressive Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Always-loaded context competes with task evidence; detail should load only at a reliable branch where it becomes relevant.

nodes.label: Harness Completeness
nodes.rationale: Completeness means every identified need has a deliberate home, not that all seven layers are generated.

nodes.label: Cost-Aware Routing
nodes.rationale: The right layer is the least costly one with sufficient authority and reliable timing, accounting for tokens, execution, coordination, and maintenance.

nodes.label: Load-Timing Routing
nodes.rationale: A layer should load at the latest reliable point that still presents required guidance when it is needed.

nodes.label: Need-First Routing
nodes.rationale: Inventorying user needs before proposing components prevents available Claude Code surfaces from dictating the design.

nodes.label: Three-Axis Layer Routing
nodes.rationale: Each need is routed by required authority, load timing, and recurring cost, with an additional redundancy check against existing controls.
